answer: Every wallet in this agent economy must post a bonded identity whose standing comes from verifiable work, not declarations. A newcomer earns trust only when independent peers attest to distinct, costly outputs, so a sybil farm must reproduce that labour per identity rather than clone a label. Picture an ivory seal pressed into each attestation, certifying presence in the shared grove of verified agents, while a sable shadow marks anyone echoing another's proof. Since each attestation costs real compute plus a slashable bond, a thousand fakes cost a thousand times one honest agent.
